$comment: Committed baseline for the Worker startup budget, measured by scripts/check-worker-startup.js against a synthetic app (procedures x tables, every function module importing one shared module that imports @lunora/auth). Cloudflare rejects a Worker whose global scope takes more than 1 s of CPU to evaluate (error 10021, not raisable). eagerModules / eagerBytes are the modules reachable from the entry through STATIC imports only (dynamic import() edges excluded): deterministic, unlike CPU time, which is printed as advisory and never gates. `pnpm run worker-startup:update` re-baselines an intentional change.
